svg.aria-label: Safety ladder: pen and hop cap, upstream command gate, on-car deadman, STOP ALL and operator stop, decider gate, marshal's thumb, each with its measured latency

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: Six layers between a spoken word and the wheels

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: Red layers are physics or the car's own code: they stop the car without the laptop. The violet layer explains; it is never the safety layer.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

text.tspan: 2×2 m low-lipped pen; |linear| ≤ 0.3 m/s and every hop ≤ 2 s in the driver, so one hop is at most 60 cm and the
lip catches the rest. Bounded travel with no software in the loop.

text.tspan: _command_gate allow-list for /manual_drive, /vehicle_state and /enable_state; every publish audited; persistent
publishers so the first ServoCtrlMsg reaches the PWM fast; a trailing zero pair ends every drive.

text.tspan: No heartbeat for 300 ms → ten zero servo pairs at 20 Hz and the tail LED turns red. Survives a laptop crash,
Wi-Fi loss or the router being pulled. Re-arms after a steady second of heartbeats.

svg.text: STOP ALL and the operator's stop

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
text.tspan: A barge-in word over Nova Sonic fires stop_all: 22 ms to PWM neutral. The operator's stop() lands in 35 ms (234
ms before the persistent publishers). Both beat the deadman gap, so the laptop's own stop arrives first.

text.tspan: Two typed questions per hop to a local Strands Decider 2B: is the command inside the envelope (225–252 ms), what
is in the frame (429–475 ms). Proceed, Guide, Confirm or Deny, with a reason the rover can say out loud.
